purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, current portal routes, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Official Board of Revenue Sindh material establishes Sindh Zameen as the provincial public land-record service and lists a Mirpurkhas district service centre. No anonymous safe ID-plus-complete-polygon response was obtained.
registryAssessment: Local/provincial registry custody found through the official Sindh Zameen portal and its official active-centres page, which names Mirpurkhas. This is not treated as proof of citywide geometry availability.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Board of Revenue Sindh portal advertises public land-record search, Maps/Deh Maps, property registers and related revenue services.
Official active-centres page lists Mirpurkhas as a district service centre and identifies its district manager. Contact details were not retained.
Official FAQ says data for all Sindh districts and most dehs is available, describes Village Forms II, VII-A and VII-B, and directs users to service centres for certified copies.
Official map index includes a District Mirpur Khas base-map entry; this is a general map reference, not verified parcel geometry.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Sindh Zameen is a provincial public land-record service with advertised Deh Maps; Mirpurkhas has an official district service-centre listing.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official portal/service-centre and general map-index evidence verified; no anonymous complete-polygon feature response verified.

remainingUncertainty: HTTP portal access, HTTPS certificate mismatch, map-host DNS failure and CAPTCHA are route/access findings only, not evidence of cadastral absence. CRS, schema, native identity, parcel coverage and citywide completeness remain unverified.
